title: Q-STD-changelog-semver: Generate CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog) and SemVer releases from Conventional Commits
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** OPEN-STANDARDS-1 register entry `keep-a-changelog-semver` is planned or partial in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation openstd --probe keep-a-changelog-semver
**Status:** open

Render CHANGELOG.md from ops/changelog.json public rows grouped by Added/Changed/Fixed using the Conventional Commits type (seed/scripts/openstd.py conventional), and derive the next SemVer from feat/fix/! markers; have the lane title its own PRs as `type(scope): subject`.

**Prediction:** conventional_commit_share >= 0.9 within 336 h

**Out of scope:** Rewriting old commit messages.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation openstd --probe keep-a-changelog-semver` exits 0.
